_doc: §3.3a write-set obligations for modules 01-06: every writer footprint (footprints/NN.json, role writer/both) whose declared or journal-observed writes meet an invariant's read set. A pair is 'mc' when the invariant's explorer family models that writer (the reviewed design passes; the as-built violation is the cited finding), 'finding' when only a finding covers it, else 'open'.
